$comment: The coverage gaps of en frozen by scripts/units/coverage.js --freeze. This list may only SHRINK: a gap that is closed is taken off it (the gate fails until it is), and no new gap may be added to make a build pass. 2026-11-23: the ten Kindergarten science gaps (7 unit checks, the 3 checks of the year) were added ONCE as a new subject was first measured (Stage D, plan decision 7): the card-based check engine cannot read the science pages yet; an observation check or a card form of the pages closes them. 2026-11-24: the ten Grade 1 science gaps were added ONCE as the Grade 1 science plan was first measured (decision 7): 6 unit checks and the 3 checks of the year for the same reason as Kindergarten, and weeks:plan-1-science because the plan fills 27 of 28 weeks (its 83 sessions are 27.7 weeks; each unit rounds to whole weeks). 2026-11-24: the nine Grade 2 science gaps were added ONCE as the Grade 2 science plan was first measured (decision 7): 6 unit checks and the 3 checks of the year, for the same reason (the plan itself fills its 28 weeks). 2026-11-24: the nine Grade 3 science gaps were added ONCE as the Grade 3 science plan was first measured (decision 7): 5 unit checks and the 3 checks of the year for the same reason as Kindergarten, and weeks:plan-3-science because the plan fills 25 of the 26 teaching weeks its design gives Grade 3 (the state test weeks take the science block; its 76 sessions are 25.3 weeks; each unit rounds to whole weeks).
